from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    """Fill frame interiors: when both interior dimensions are even, use 2; otherwise 7."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    frames = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if (all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                frames.append((-(r1-r0)*(c1-c0), r0, r1, c0, c1, color))
    # Outer regions fill first; smaller nested frames then overlay them.
    for _, r0, r1, c0, c1, color in sorted(frames):
        ih, iw = r1 - r0 - 1, c1 - c0 - 1
        fill = 2 if ih % 2 == 0 and iw % 2 == 0 else 7
        for y in range(r0+1, r1):
            for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                out[y][x] = fill
    return out
